title: UE-initiated de-registration procedure completion for 5GS services over non-3GPP access

entities.name: UE-initiated de-registration procedure for non-3GPP access
entities.description: Procedure for UE-initiated de-registration from 5GS services over non-3GPP access, involving PDU session release and state transitions.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate de-registration procedure.

entities.name: Access type
entities.description: Information element indicating the access type (non-3GPP) for de-registration.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state indicating the UE is de-registered for non-3GPP access.

entities.name: 5GMM-NULL
entities.description: 5GMM state indicating no NAS signaling connection exists for non-3GPP access.

entities.name: De-registration not due to switch off
entities.description: Condition where de-registration is initiated for reasons other than UE switch off.

entities.name: Disabling of 5GS services
entities.description: Condition where 5GS services are being disabled for non-3GPP access.

entities.name: UE marked as inactive for 5GS services over non-3GPP access
entities.description: Property where AMF marks the UE as inactive for 5GS services over non-3GPP access.

entities.name: PDU session release over non-3GPP access
entities.description: Property describing the release of PDU sessions and user plane resources over non-3GPP access.

relations.description: Procedure is initiated by DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST contains access type IE indicating non-3GPP access.
Procedure includes release of PDU sessions and user plane resources over non-3GPP access.
Procedure results in UE being marked as inactive in AMF for non-3GPP access.
Procedure completion causes AMF to enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for non-3GPP access.
If de-registration is not due to switch off, condition for disabling 5GS services determines UE state.
If de-registration is due to disabling 5GS services, UE enters 5GMM-NULL state for non-3GPP access.
If de-registration is not due to switch off and not due to disabling 5GS services, UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for non-3GPP access.
